title: Business logic, races, money paths
status: AUTHORED. The domain no scanner can reach, because the bug is that the code does exactly what it says.

atom_notes.A10: the workflow assumes an invariant the attacker can break, and every field is valid alone
atom_notes.A12: the window between a check and its use is the whole attack in the concurrency case
atom_notes.A04: the system view of state diverges from real state, and stays diverged

required_cells.why: model the intended workflow before breaking it, or you are poking at random
replay needs automation and exact ordering
the exploit is a sequence or a timing, not a payload
the control is a sequential run that must NOT reproduce
money impact framing, or it gets triaged as intended behaviour

entries.name: race-the-web
entries.role: Parallel request harness to find state races
preconditions: a way to observe final state
entries.note: Not on PyPI. Build from source. The control matters more than the tool: run the same requests sequentially first and show it does not reproduce.

entries.name: Turbo Intruder (Burp extension)
entries.role: Last byte sync and single packet attack, the serious tool for single endpoint races
oracle: state that only breaks when requests land together
entries.note: Single packet attack over HTTP/2 is the only reliable way to test a race on a modern stack. Anything else is hoping.

entries.name: newman
entries.role: Replay a multi step sequence deterministically, which is how logic bugs get proven
preconditions: a collection built from captured traffic
oracle: a sequence producing an impossible outcome

entries.name: mitmproxy
entries.role: Replay and reorder requests, including dropping responses to test retry logic
oracle: the same request replayed with a different outcome

entries.name: WSTG Business Logic (11 tests)
entries.role: The test list for this domain

entries.name: PortSwigger: race conditions
entries.role: The best current explanation, including the single packet attack

entries.name: HackTricks
entries.role: Per platform logic and race technique reference

entries.name: rea capture_browser_scenario
entries.role: Deterministic capture of a multi step flow so a sequence can be replayed exactly
oracle: the exact request sequence with ordering

tree.q: Is the bug about order and timing, or about a rule?
tree.why: Two different failures. Races break an assumption about concurrency. Logic breaks an assumption about sequence or value. The control differs.

branches.action: model the state transition, then send the pair together. sequential run first as the control
branches.oracle: final state impossible sequentially, with the sequential control not reproducing

branches.action: write the rule as the app states it, then find the sequence that satisfies every field check and violates the rule
branches.oracle: an outcome the business rule forbids

branches.action: drop the response and resend. if the effect doubles, the operation is not idempotent
change the object between steps. the approver sees one thing and applies another
branches.oracle: applied object differs from the approved summary

mirror.control: range and sign checks per field

mirror.rule: state change without a transition event

gaps.gap: No tool that models a business workflow and generates violating sequences
gaps.build_candidate: derive the state machine from captured traffic, then search for sequences reaching a privileged state without the required steps

gaps.gap: No race harness that automatically builds the sequential control
gaps.build_candidate: every parallel run emits a paired sequential run and compares outcomes
impact template per logic class with the monetary or entitlement delta stated
